endpoints.description: Run unconditional generation. Returns a JobInfo; poll until completed.

request_fields.name: model_name
request_fields.description: Which pre-staged variant to use: {qm9,drugs}_{diffusion,fm,quick}. `drugs_*` are drug-like (GEOM-Drugs); `qm9_*` are small molecules. Only variants present on NAS are usable — check /api/models or /healthz/detail.

request_fields.name: n_molecules
request_fields.description: Number of molecules to generate. Batched internally; runtime scales with ceil(n_molecules / batch_size) sampling passes.

request_fields.name: n_atoms_per_mol
request_fields.description: If set, every molecule has exactly this many atoms. Default (null) samples atom counts from the training size distribution (train_n_h.pickle) — recommended. Model tested up to 125 atoms.

request_fields.name: timesteps
request_fields.description: Number of sampling steps. Diffusion default 500; flow-matching variants work well at ~100. Fewer = faster, lower quality.

request_fields.name: batch_size
request_fields.description: Internal sampling batch size. n_molecules > batch_size is split into multiple passes automatically.

request_fields.name: seed
request_fields.description: Random seed (torch.manual_seed). null → unseeded; recorded in JobInfo.input_params.
request_fields.default_note: random seed selected by the tool at runtime

examples.notes: Returns a JobInfo; poll /api/jobs/<id> until completed, then GET /api/jobs/<id>/file/generated_molecules.sdf.

examples.title: FC async task mode (single 202 + blocking compute)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/tasks/generate -H 'X-Fc-Invocation-Type: Async' -H 'X-Bioagent-Job-Id: my-job-001' -F model_name=drugs_diffusion -F n_molecules=100
examples.notes: Returns 202 immediately; FC keeps the instance alive until sampling completes. Preferred production entry.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: Megalodon
model.paper: Reidenbach et al., arXiv:2505.18392 (2025) — EGNN-Transformer co-design, diffusion + flow matching
model.output_format: generated_molecules.sdf (RDKit SDF, N molecules) + metrics.json (2D/3D/train-data) + generation_stats.json

tool_outputs.generate: output/generated_molecules.sdf — up to n_molecules valid 3D molecules (SDF). Actual count <= n_molecules (unbuildable graphs skipped). output/metrics.json reports generative metrics; output/generation_stats.json reports n_valid vs n_requested + timing.

config_tips.model_name: drugs_* = drug-like (GEOM-Drugs); qm9_* = small molecules. *_diffusion = highest quality; *_fm = flow matching (fast at ~100 steps); *_quick = lighter/faster architecture.
config_tips.n_atoms_per_mol: null samples atom counts from the training distribution (recommended); set an int to fix molecule size.
